name: Last Users Order Column for WooCommerce
author: wpgenie2

sections.description:
Last Users Order Column for WooCommerce enhances the WordPress users admin screen by adding a “Last Order” column that displays the date of each customer’s most recent WooCommerce order.

This feature provides instant visibility into customer purchase activity directly from the users list, helping administrators quickly identify active, inactive, or dormant customers without navigating to individual user profiles or running separate reports. The plugin is lightweight, requires no configuration, and works seamlessly with your existing WooCommerce setup.

Features

  • Adds a “Last Order” column to the WordPress users list
  • Adds a “Last Active” column to the WordPress users list
  • Columns are sortable
  • Displays the most recent order date for each customer
  • Columns for easy analysis of customer activity
  • No configuration required — works immediately upon activation
  • Seamless integration with the WordPress admin interface
  • Provides a quick overview of customer purchase history and activity

Use Cases

  • Identify inactive customers for targeted re-engagement campaigns
  • Quickly assess and segment customer activity levels
  • Filter and differentiate between active and dormant accounts
  • Streamline workflows for customer service and support teams
  • Monitor overall customer engagement at a glance

Support

You can contact us at our website wpgenie.org if you have problems or questions.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or greater

Setup

This section describes how to install OnSale Page for WooCommerce plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WordPress user list.

If you have any problems contact us at http://wpgenie.org/
